mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mqtt_simulation_config (user_id, config_name, data_type, value1, value2, device_id, auto_send, send_interval, is_enabled) VALUES (#{userId}, #{configName}, #{dataType}, #{value1}, #{value2}, #{deviceId}, #{autoSend}, #{sendInterval}, #{isEnabled})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM mqtt_simulation_config WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE mqtt_simulation_config SET auto_send = #{autoSend} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE mqtt_simulation_config SET is_enabled = #{isEnabled} WHERE id = #{id}
